SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) courseId,c.name courseName,COUNT(p.id) practiceCount,COUNT(DISTINCT p.student_id) participantCount, COALESCE(SUM(p.question_count),0) answerCount,COALESCE(SUM(p.correct_count),0) correctCount, ROUND(SUM(p.correct_count)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(p.question_count),0),1) accuracy FROM course c LEFT JOIN practice p ON p.course_id=c.id AND p.status='SUBMITTED' AND p.archived=0 AND p.student_id=#{studentId} WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY c.id,c.name,c.sort_order ORDER BY c.sort_order,c.id

SELECT CAST(k.id AS CHAR) knowledgeId,CONCAT(k.name,CASE WHEN ch.is_current=0 THEN '（旧题库）' ELSE '' END) knowledgeName,CAST(k.chapter_id AS CHAR) chapterId, COUNT(DISTINCT qk.question_id) bankCount,COUNT(r.id) questionCount,COALESCE(SUM(r.is_correct),0) correctCount,COUNT(DISTINCT r.student_id) participantCount FROM knowledge_point k JOIN chapter ch ON ch.id=k.chapter_id LEFT JOIN question_knowledge qk ON qk.knowledge_id=k.id LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.question_id=qk.question_id AND r.rn=1 WHERE ch.course_id=#{courseId} GROUP BY k.id,k.name,k.chapter_id,ch.sort_order,k.sort_order,ch.is_current HAVING ch.is_current=1 OR COUNT(r.id)>0 ORDER BY ch.sort_order,k.sort_order,k.id

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) practiceId,question_count questionCount,correct_count correctCount,ROUND(correct_count*100.0/question_count,1) accuracy,submitted_at submittedAt FROM practice WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND course_id=#{courseId} AND status='SUBMITTED' AND archived=0 ORDER BY submitted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20

WITH history AS ( SELECT i.*,p.course_id,p.submitted_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY i.question_id ORDER BY p.submitted_at DESC,p.id DESC,i.id DESC) recentRank FROM practice_item i JOIN practice p ON p.id=i.practice_id WHERE p.student_id=#{studentId} AND p.status='SUBMITTED' AND p.archived=0
), errors AS ( SELECT h.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY h.question_id ORDER BY h.submitted_at DESC,h.practice_id DESC,h.id DESC) errorRank, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY h.question_id) wrongCount FROM history h WHERE h.is_correct=0 )

FROM errors e JOIN question q ON q.id=e.question_id JOIN history latest ON latest.question_id=e.question_id AND latest.recentRank=1 WHERE e.errorRank=1 AND e.course_id=#{courseId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_knowledge qk WHERE qk.question_id=q.id AND qk.knowledge_id=#{knowledgeId})
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(u.id AS CHAR) studentId,u.username,u.real_name realName,COUNT(p.id) practiceCount,COALESCE(SUM(p.question_count),0) answerCount,COALESCE(SUM(p.correct_count),0) correctCount,ROUND(SUM(p.correct_count)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(p.question_count),0),1) accuracy FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN practice p ON p.student_id=u.id AND p.course_id=#{courseId} AND p.status='SUBMITTED' AND p.archived=0 WHERE u.role='STUDENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM course_enrollment e WHERE e.student_id=u.id AND e.course_id=#{courseId}) GROUP BY u.id,u.username,u.real_name ORDER BY u.username LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
